negative.sql: SELECT day::date AS missing_date FROM generate_series('2022-01-01'::date, '2022-01-10'::date, '1 day'::interval) AS day WHERE day::date NOT IN (SELECT visit_date FROM person_visits WHERE person_id = 1 OR person_id = 2) ORDER BY missing_date;

SELECT day::date AS missing_date
FROM generate_series('2022-01-01'::date, '2022-01-10'::date, '1 day'::interval) AS day
LEFT JOIN (SELECT visit_date
           FROM person_visits
           WHERE person_id = 1) AS visits
       ON visits.visit_date = day::date
WHERE visits.visit_date IS NULL
ORDER BY missing_date;
